items.name: AM2R: Another Metroid 2 Remake
items.description:
Custom/manual achievements for AM2R, a fanmade remake of Metroid II. Requires at least v1.4 of AM2R for the added game modes.
Most achievement progress can be checked on the main menu through the Gallery and the stats listed on save files.
items.author: IggniFyre

items.name: Banjo-Kazooie (Recompiled)
items.description:
Custom/manual achievements for Banjo Recompiled, a fanmade native PC port of Banjo-Kazooie.
Achievements designed so that achievement progress can checked through the 'View Totals' screen on the in-game pause menu.
items.author: IggniFyre

items.name: Crash Team Racing: Nitro-Fueled (custom)
items.description:
Custom/Manual achievement set for Crash Team Racing Nitro-Fueled, for Nintendo Switch or the fanmade PC port.
This is a custom set different from the official achievements on Playstation and Xbox. Achievements centered around including the additional free content that was added post-launch, which also contains much more challenging Time Trials.
See notes for important details.

items.name: Hyrule Warriors: Definitive Edition
items.description:
Custom Nintendo Switch achievement set for Hyrule Warriors: Definitive Edition. Achievements are based on content exclusive to Hyrule Warriors Legends on the 3DS and Definitive Edition on Switch, and so can not be completed on the Wii U verison.
Achievement progress can be checked through the in-game Medals in the Gallery and completion percentages on the Adventure Mode menu.
items.author: IggniFyre

items.name: Jak and Daxter: The Precursor Legacy (OpenGOAL)
items.description:
Custom/manual achievements for Jak and Daxter: The Precursor Legacy through OpenGOAL, the playable fanmade recompilation/PC port of the original engine used for the Jak trilogy.
Achievements primarily based on level completion, achievement progress can be checked through the pause menu's level overview and file select screen.

items.name: Rayman 2: The Great Escape
items.description:
Custom/Manual achievements for Rayman 2: The Great Escape, for those that prefer playing the original PC or GOG versions of Rayman 2 instead of using RetroAchievements compatible versions of the game.
Achievements primarily based on completion so progress can be checked through the in-game level select or file select menu.
items.author: IggniFyre

items.name: Rayman 3: Hoodlum Havoc
items.description:
Custom/Manual achievements for Rayman 3: Hoodlum Havoc, for those that prefer playing the original PC or GOG versions of Rayman 3 instead of using RetroAchievements compatible versions of the game.
Achievements primarily based on completion so progress can be checked through the in-game pause menu.
items.author: IggniFyre

items.name: Rayman Redemption
items.description:
Manual PlayniteAchievements set for Rayman Redemption, a fanmade remake of the original Rayman.
All achievements taken directly from the in-game achievement system and can be tracked through the Extras menu.
items.author: IggniFyre

items.name: Sonic and the Secret Rings (Project Reignition)
items.description:
Manual PlayniteAchievement set for Sonic Project Reignition, a fanmade remake for Sonic and the Secret Rings.
Contains all achievements from the in-game achievement system, with additional achievements for unlocking the other extras in the Special Book.
items.author: IggniFyre

items.name: Sonic Heroes
items.description:
Custom/Manual achievements for Sonic Heroes, for those that prefer playing the original PC version instead of using RetroAchievements compatible versions of the game.
All achievement progress can be checked through the game's file select and Story menu.
items.author: IggniFyre

items.name: Sonic 1 Forever
items.description:
Manual PlayniteAchievements set for Sonic 1 Forever, a fanmade recompiled native PC port of the RetroEngine version of Sonic the Hedghehog released on Android with additional features, created by Team Forever.
All manual achievements and icons taken directly from Sonic 1 Forever's existing in-game achievements, with additional custom achievements for each playable character.
items.author: IggniFyre

items.name: Sonic 2 Absolute
items.description:
Manual PlayniteAchievements set for Sonic 2 Absolute, a fanmade recompiled native PC port of the RetroEngine version of Sonic the Hedghehog 2 released on Android with additional features, created by Team Forever.
All manual achievements and icons taken directly from Sonic 2 Absolute's existing in-game achievements, with additional custom achievements for each playable character.
items.author: IggniFyre

items.name: Sonic 3 A.I.R.
items.description:
Manual PlayniteAchievements set for Sonic 3 A.I.R. (Angel Island Revisited), a fanmade recompiled native PC port of Sonic the Hedgehog 3 & Knuckles.
All manual achievements and icons taken directly from Sonic 3 A.I.R.'s existing in-game achievements, with additional custom achievements for each playable character.
items.author: IggniFyre

items.name: Sonic the Hedgehog: Project 06
items.description: Custom/manual achievements for Sonic: Project 06, a fanmade remake of Sonic the Hedgehog (2006). Most achievement progress can be checked by viewing your rank result on the stage select screen. Renders used for achievement icons created by ChaosX, the creator of Project 06.
items.author: IggniFyre

items.name: Super Mario 64
items.description:
Custom/Manual achievements for Super Mario 64 to be used on any of the fanmade PC ports of the Super Mario 64 decompilation, such as Render96, Super Mario 64 Plus, sm64coop, etc.
Most achievements based on level completion so that progression can be easily checked through the in-game pause menu.
items.author: IggniFyre

items.name: Super Mario Bros. Remastered
items.description:
Manual PlayniteAchievements set for Super Mario Bros. Remastered, a fanmade remaster of the original Super Mario Bros. with many additional features.
All achievements and icons taken directly from the in-game achievement system, progression can be checked through the Extras menu.
items.author: IggniFyre

items.name: The Legend of Zelda: Breath of the Wild
items.description:
Custom Nintendo Switch or Wii U achievement set for The Legend of Zelda: Breath of the Wild.
All achievement progress can be checked in the game's Quest menu, Inventory, or Compendium.
